False reporting
23 Apr, 2014 @ 4:14pm
Just
This is were the line between "that person's only intent was to feed" and "I don't like how good this player is" blurs. To report that Pudge for intentionaly feeding when really he was, a) having a bad game, b) new to pudge, or c) miscommunicating with the team, is a false report and should not carry a punishment to anyone who has been false reported.

I will admit it, I have indeed false reported serval people when they did not deserve it, and I have been muted multiple times. Mutes are mostly justified in my opinion.
